question: Whose statue was unveiled at Raj Bhavan, Goa, by the Vice-President of India and is known as the 'Father of Medicine' in ancient Indian history?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charaka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The statue of **Charaka**, renowned as the **"Father of Medicine"** in ancient India, was unveiled by the **Vice-President of India**, **Jagdeep Dhankhar**.
 
• The unveiling ceremony took place at the **Raj Bhavan** in **Goa** in **November 2023**, coinciding with events celebrating India's rich medicinal heritage.
 
• **Charaka** was a principal contributor to **Ayurveda**, the traditional Indian system of medicine, and is best known for authoring the **Charaka Samhita**.
 
• He served as a court physician during the reign of the **Kushana King Kanishka** around the **1st or 2nd century CE**.
 
• His teachings emphasized that **prevention is better than cure**, and he focused on the holistic well-being of the human body through a balance of **Vata, Pitta, and Kapha**.
